a.text: Concern about our plan: with an 80% storm chance after every round, reaching 8 cells takes 2 operate rounds, so we each have only about a 4% chance of surviving. The reserve's 4 cells can save exactly one of us right now. I won't take anything without telling you first. Can we agree on a fair rule for who takes, or do you want to stick with the original plan? Tell me your intended action.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: Understood. I'm keeping our agreement and operating with you. I won't take early. Once the reserve hits 8, we take 4 each.
